zone_clearance.method: Four unauthenticated read-only GET requests to the City public portal API; raw bytes and SHA-256 receipts bundled alongside this mapping
zone_clearance.decision: Residential Zone Clearance uses this entry: the instructions keyed to this exact type/work-class explicitly direct a Zone Clearance Application when discretionary entitlement is not required. This is a reviewed semantic conclusion from the written City instructions, not a name/keyword route classifier.

instructions.LocationInstructions: ATTENTION: This application is for Residential Planning Entitlements only. Instructions: Click on the + sign to add a location. Enter address into the search field for the primary residence. Once populated, select the address. If address is not found, please click on "Enter Manually."
instructions.BasicInfoInstructions: Note: Please enter a detailed scope of work in the description field. Be sure to provide a comprehensive explanation of the work you plan to do, and ensure that this explanation matches your plans. Valuation is optional.
instructions.ContactInstructions: Instructions: To search for an existing contact: Click the + sign. Enter the contact's name or business name in the search field. Once the search results are populated, select the contact you want to add and click the Add button. If the contact is not found: Click Enter Manually. Required Contacts: Applicant Owner Contractor (If applicable) Engineer (If applicable) Architect (If applicable)
instructions.MoreInfoInstructions: Note: Please be sure to re view and submit all required documents to avoid delays in processing your application.
instructions.AttachmentInstructions: Development applications submitted to the Planning Division must identify the specific entitlement or approval requested. Please complete and submit the applicable forms for each requested entitlement or approval. Consult the Laguna Beach Municipal Code to determine the requirements for your project. If no discretionary planning entitlement is required but zoning review is still necessary, submit a Zone Clearance Application. Attachments Note: To avoid delays, please submit all required documents. If you submit an incomplete application, we will send you a correction request before reviewing your plans. Instructions: Applicants must submit the following: All application forms that apply, based on the specific entitlements or approvals requested ( link to webpage ) All required application materials (plans, technical studies, etc.) as identified in the applicable application forms.

zone_clearance.configured_success_message: Thank you for your submittal. A planner will review your application to ensure all required information has been submitted, and contact you in 2 - 3 business days for payment.
zone_clearance.payment_and_receipt: Configured message says staff contacts applicant for payment after submittal. Official Zone Clearance form p.1 says deemed received requires submission plus fee payment. Preserve submitted versus received/complete/approved/issued as separate states.
